items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I took some saxophone lessons from one of the Brown Brothers.

ctx.x: I'll tell you something funny about that, if you -- I was at that time not exactly the greatest reader in the world. My formal musical education had -- I had studied

piano for a couple of years. I knew the notes and everything, and I took some saxophone lessons from one of the Brown Brothers. There used to be a saxophone band called The Six Brown Brothers, and I had taken lessons from one of them.
